structure.unit: Provisions Relating to Accident and Sickness Insurance

text.section: Coverage for emergency services that are related to mental health services or substance abuse services, as those terms are defined in § 38.2-3412.1, shall be provided in accordance with the federal Mental Health Parity and Addiction Equity Act of 2008, P.L. 110-343, even where those requirements would not otherwise apply directly. Such emergency services may be rendered at a location other than the emergency department of a hospital, such as a behavioral health crisis service provider, as required.
